title: Pope John Paul II: 'we are not alone'

tellings.quote: But back then, when I met the Roman Pope in 1994, I didn't quite understand it.

plain: Pope John Paul II told him "we are not alone" when they met in 1994, according to Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997. He tells Michels he did not quite understand the Pope's meaning at the time, implying that it only made sense to him after his own experience.
